summary: Frontend retest of /jobs tabs and /map regression (logged in as chattest@example.com). All tabs (search, platforms, offers, seekers) switch with no crash or white screen, and there were 0 page errors. Platforms view shows 8 platform buttons. Clicking Indeed opens a new tab (https://fr.indeed.com/jobs?q=emprego&l=Brasil). Clicking search-all with an empty input shows the toast 'Digite algo para buscar'. With 'garçom' typed, it opens 3 tabs (Indeed, LinkedIn, France Travail) and shows a success toast. The Offers and Seekers views each render jobs-empty-state (no posts in DB). /map still renders data-testid=google-map with markers.

issues: The platforms are French sites (fr.indeed, France Travail, Leboncoin, APEC), but the default location is 'Brasil' and the default query is 'emprego' (Portuguese). So the platform URLs get l=Brasil, which gives poor results on French job boards. Consider defaulting to France/Paris, or translating the query the same way searchExternalJobs does with translateSearchTerm.

action_items: Optional: in generateSearchUrl, apply translateSearchTerm and a France-appropriate default location for the French platforms
critical_code_review_comments: JobsPage.js is about 757 lines (over 700). Consider moving the platforms and offers/seekers blocks into separate components.
The search and location inputs had no data-testid. Added jobs-search-input and jobs-location-input.
